acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: The search parameters were as followed: tryptic digestion with a maximum of 2 missed cleavages, peptide length = 7-50, peptide tolerance = 20 ppm; MS/MS tolerance = 10 ppm; topN peaks = 300; fixed modifications = carbamidomethyl on cysteine and TMT18plex on lysine; variable modifications = acetylation on protein N termini, oxidation of methionine and TMT18plex on peptide N termini.

fractionation_method.evidence: After TMT18plex labeling pepties were separated into 12 fractions by high pH, followed by LC-MS on a Qexactive.
